source_state: uncommitted signed logical host reads, checked strided-view geometry and migrated observation/route-coordinate readers
behavior: The additive signed-stride C API preserves MLX int64 strides instead of interpreting reversed strides as unsigned sizes. Checked host layout geometry bounds element counts, byte spans and signed pointer displacement.

Borrowed Rust slices reject noncontiguous logical storage and misalignment. Empty slices and vectors return empty without dereferencing native storage; dtype checks still apply. Owned logical reads support negative, zero and irregular strides and use unaligned value copies.

Owned vectors and widened observations preallocate exact logical capacities, including scalar results. This avoids generic iterator collection minimum-growth slack and keeps actual Vec capacities equal to the priced logical payloads.

The borrowing exact-size, double-ended logical iterator enables direct integer widening and coordinate iteration without a numerical payload. Native-byte export allocates one final byte vector; equality allocates no payload and retains floating NaN/signed-zero semantics.

The safe as_strided wrapper validates shape/stride rank, nonnegative extents, default-stride overflow, source-relative endpoints and native signed arithmetic before constructing a lazy graph. It uses the native operation’s logically flattened source semantics.

Observation collection and routed capture/intervention coordinate readers consume the iterator directly and preserve native read errors through a neutral neural error source. Native routed capture tests now pass genuinely strided unsigned token/selection views through normalization without forcing an incidental cast copy.

Host fixtures exercise capacity-backed prefixes, transposes, scalar and row broadcasts including 4097 aliases of one element, reversed axes, singleton-axis arbitrary strides, empty/scalar inputs, unaligned dtype views and all fourteen native scalar representations. Value/byte checks are exact, including NaN payload bytes.

Five completed Metal layouts retain identical active allocations and a zero reset peak during logical vector reads, byte export and equality. The runtime does not allocate native compaction or staging for these host reads.

All cache-state, snapshot, prompt-cache persistence, transaction, rollback, capture and intervention tests in the selected suites pass. Snapshot independence assertions now compare complete backing-allocation identities rather than borrowing strided buffers as contiguous slices. Independent native deep_clone retains its separately priced compaction-and-copy implementation.
limits: This fixes logical copy and serialization mechanisms; complete public admission, independently streamed expert schedules, paging/materialization/transfers, complete parallel/media/speculation composition and enclosing snapshot/capture/copy retention accounting remain unfinished.
The measured no-native-staging property is for the selected Metal realization. Rust iteration itself allocates no payload; other native backends may have separate device-to-host access mechanisms.
No new native distributed or released-checkpoint numerical experiment was required for this data-copy increment. Copies preserve exact logical data and do not change model equations.

Nine focused tests overlap the full wrapper suite, giving 629 unique passing tests. The focused command explicitly runs the new ignored allocation measurement. The unrelated custom multi-output Metal kernel test remains ignored in the full wrapper suite.
Existing large-unwind linker and unused internal helper/quote warnings remain.
